children: Lufthansa Group (DLAKF) on Thursday said it will add 20 Boeing
737 MAX 10 aircraft to its fleet after its supervisory board approved the exercise of purchase options secured under a 2023.
The aircraft are part of options secured under Lufthansa’s 2023 order for 40 Boeing
737 MAX 8 jets, which included rights to purchase 60 additional aircraft from the MAX family.

Deliveries of the newly selected 737 MAX 10 aircraft are scheduled to begin in the early 2030s, Lufthansa said. The planes will gradually replace older Airbus (EADSF) A320 family aircraft across the group.

The 737 MAX 10 has greater seating capacity than the MAX 8 already on order, Lufthansa (DLAKF) said. The airline group expects the new aircraft to use about 30% less fuel than the older planes they are intended to replace, while higher capacity is expected to reduce unit costs by about 20%.
The latest order has a list value of about $3.4 billion, according to Lufthansa (DLAKF).
Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg said the company was taking longer than expected to stabilize 737 MAX production at 47 jets a month. He also said the 737-10 is nearing certification.
Lufthansa (DLAKF) expects to receive more than 250 new aircraft by 2035 as part of its fleet modernization program.

title: Lufthansa adds 20 Boeing 737 Max 10s to replace older Airbus jets
